What is Intent Data?

Intent data is information that indicates a prospect's interest in specific products, services, or business solutions. It is gathered through online activities such as content consumption, research behavior, website visits, and engagement patterns.

  • Discover Active Buyers
  • Prioritize Sales Opportunities
